nodes.label: Duplicate File Detection
nodes.rationale: Finds duplicates via md5 hash, filename, and size comparisons; always asks for confirmation before deleting to avoid destructive mistakes.

nodes.label: Organization Plan Workflow
nodes.rationale: Propose a plan (current state, proposed structure, changes) before executing, so user can approve/modify rather than have files moved without consent.

nodes.label: Think Before Coding Principle
nodes.rationale: State assumptions explicitly and surface tradeoffs instead of guessing silently, to avoid mistaken implementations from unstated assumptions.

nodes.label: Simplicity First Principle
nodes.rationale: Write the minimum code that solves the problem; avoid speculative abstractions/configurability, because unused flexibility adds maintenance cost without benefit.

nodes.label: Surgical Changes Principle
nodes.rationale: Touch only what the task requires and match existing style, so diffs stay traceable to the user's request and unrelated code isn't disturbed.

nodes.label: Goal-Driven Execution Principle
nodes.rationale: Transform tasks into verifiable success criteria (e.g. write a failing test, then make it pass) so work can be looped and verified independently instead of requiring constant clarification.

nodes.label: Sidebar Menu Order Spec
nodes.rationale: Defines the exact required order of sidebar buttons: Loja Cozy & Gacha, Aparência & Bichinhos, Minijogos, Missões Diárias, Configurações, Estatísticas de Estudo.

nodes.label: Pet Care / Friendship Level Mechanic
nodes.rationale: Each pet has a friendship XP bar leveled up via feeding/playing with purchased items (Lanchinhos, Brinquedos) using MedTokens, unlocking bonuses/cosmetics to encourage engagement.

nodes.label: Termo Cozy Minigame (Wordle-like)
nodes.rationale: 5-letter word guessing game in 6 tries modeled on term.ooo, rewarding MedTokens once per day free, extra plays cost tokens, to gamify study breaks.

nodes.label: Game Loop & State Technical Spec
nodes.rationale: Keep game state (Termo match, pet XP, food stock) in localStorage, use anime.js for animations, and validate guessed words (accent-insensitive) for a smoother UX.

nodes.label: toolSettings Per-Tool State Map
nodes.rationale: Replaces the global penColor/penSize/penOpacity variables with a per-tool settings map so pen and highlighter no longer share state and each tool remembers its own config; referenced at notes.js:1162.

nodes.label: brushType Stroke Rendering Model
nodes.rationale: Adds brushType to serialized strokes and dispatches rendering per type (ballpoint, fountain pen via pressure+velocity, pencil texture, fineliner, round/chisel highlighter, auto-straight-line) so mouse users get visually distinct pens without needing an S-Pen; old strokes default to ballpoint for backward compatibility.

nodes.label: Rich Tool Popovers (replace corner pickers)
nodes.rationale: Moves color/size/type pickers from the top-right toolbar corner into per-tool popovers opened by clicking the active tool, reusing existing _togglePopover positioning logic; referenced at notes.js:1072.

nodes.label: Régua (Ruler) Visibility + Snap Fix
nodes.rationale: Root cause: ruler only draws when _ruler.active, which is only set by clicking it while invisible (deadlock). Fix initializes ruler at viewport center on activation and projects strokes onto the ruler line for snap; referenced at notes.js:2263.

nodes.label: Texto (Text Tool) Editable + Persisted Fix
nodes.rationale: Root cause: .canvas-text-element div has no CSS and no position, and canvas-ui layer blocks clicks; it isn't persisted. Fix creates the box inside #text-overlays, adds real CSS, persists via page.textElements[], and suspends canvas-ui pointer-capture while editing; referenced at notes.js:2439.

nodes.label: Extended Persistence (Strokes + Texts)
nodes.rationale: _savePage and loadActivePage currently only handle strokes; must be extended to also serialize/restore page.textElements[] so text boxes persist across sessions.

nodes.label: Fases de Execução A-D
nodes.rationale: Ordered, independently testable phases: A) foundation (toolSettings + rich popovers), B) brush types, C) ruler, D) text — each verifiable in the browser via server.py before moving to the next.

nodes.label: Fixed Aesthetic Asset Naming Convention
nodes.rationale: Site reads these two decoration files by exact filename so users can swap assets without code changes.

nodes.label: Animal Asset Naming Convention (animal_1..12)
nodes.rationale: Numbered filenames (animal_1..animal_12, gif/png/webp) let the site auto-detect pets for the discovery 'Tinder' UI; missing files are simply skipped to avoid broken links.

nodes.label: Background Asset Naming Convention (bg_1..12)
nodes.rationale: Numbered filenames (bg_1..bg_12, jpg/png/gif/webp) let the site auto-detect backgrounds for the discovery 'Tinder' UI; missing slots are skipped to avoid broken links.
